description_en: Queries the rules in a specified account group
description_zh: 查询指定账号组内的规则列表
kebab_example: aliyun config list-aggregate-config-rules --config-rule-state ACTIVE --compliance-type COMPLIANT --risk-level 1 --compliance-pack-id cp-fe416457e0d900220000 --config-rule-name The_name_of_the_rule. --aggregator-id ca-f632626622af00790000 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --tag Value=value-1 Key=key-1 --keyword ecs --resource-types ACS::ECS::Instance --sort-by CreateDate-Desc --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAggregateConfigRules

parameters.description_en:
The state of the rule. Valid values:

- ACTIVE: The rule is enabled.

- DELETING: The rule is being deleted.

- EVALUATING: The rule is being evaluated.

- INACTIVE: The rule is disabled.

- COMPLIANT: The resource is compliant.

- NOT\_APPLICABLE: The rule does not apply to the resource.

- INSUFFICIENT\_DATA: No data is available.
